name: YOU&!
source:
A worthless, pathetic girl notices You and falls obsessively in love. In a f*cked up joke from the universe, You noticed her back. Will You change her, or will You destroy her?

This is a story about toxic girl love.

There are no 'good girls' here.

There are no good endings.

There's only You and I. And misery.

A dark psychological yuri story about the seemingly un-breakable cycles that make us, us.

[Edited from [url=https://infinitestars.itch.io/you]itch.io[/url]]
